meta.description: Get every Pyreon post the day it goes out: deep dives into the compiler and runtime, measured benchmarks and release notes.

hero.title: Every post, the day it goes out.
hero.lede: Deep dives into how the compiler and the runtime work, benchmark results with the losses left in, and release write-ups. The email list opens with the launch; the RSS feed already carries every post in full, the moment it is published.

feed.title: Add the feed anywhere.
feed.text: Paste this address into any feed reader, or into an RSS-to-email service to get each post by mail.
feed.note: Prefer GitHub? Watch pyreon/pyreon and choose Custom → Releases to get a notification for each release.
